reviewSessionBrief.humanGoal: Use realistic AI reviewer and human author feedback loops to improve AI Markdown Review Loop until no actionable product feedback remains.
reviewSessionBrief.commentStyle: Prefer concrete review threads with a question, suggested patch, or explicit blocker. Avoid broad style-only feedback.
reviewSessionBrief.doneWhen: Every collected improvement is either implemented or converted into regression guidance; remainingFeedback is empty.

rounds.name: AI first pass leaves review comments
rounds.humanPrompt: Review the rich Markdown fixture like a real AI reviewer. Leave comments that a human author can answer.

humanInputs.text: The reviewer needs my current review goal too. This pass is product/agent handoff, not grammar.
Cover rendered block edits first, and report ordinary source edits as approximate unless confidence is high.
Apply the patch only if the target is exact; otherwise explain why it is blocked.

aiFollowUps.text: I will treat this as a session-level review instruction: product/agent handoff issues should outrank grammar comments.

improvementsApplied: Add a review session brief concept to prompts and export guidance.
Keep vague human replies visible as handoff warnings instead of treating them as decisions.

rounds.name: Human challenges AI feedback and AI revises in-thread
rounds.humanPrompt: Continue the same threads. Do not open duplicates if my reply changes the interpretation.

humanInputs.text: I disagree because the duplicate sentence is intentional test data for repeated-anchor matching.
I already edited that sentence. Revise the patch against the current source instead of telling me to refresh.
Please revise this patch so it names sidecar sync explicitly.

aiFollowUps.text: Good catch. I should revise this as a test-data note instead of suggesting deletion.

Suggested patch revision:
```diff
- An AI suggested patch that no longer matches the source is shown as stale rather than as an applyable green button.
+ An AI suggested patch that no longer matches the source is shown as stale, and a revised sidecar patch updates the preview without manual refresh.
```

Suggested patch revision:
```diff
- Human -->|Apply Patch| Patch[Review-aware edit]
+ Human -->|Apply Patch| Patch[Review-aware Markdown and sidecar edit]
```

improvementsApplied: Keep AI revised patch candidates as replies with a Suggested patch revision label and fenced diff.
Keep Apply Patch and Close gated on exact current Markdown targets.
